sampling: Four separate Release processes per experiment and RAW, with the switched option set to 0, 1, 1, 0 for diagnostics, or 0, unset, unset, 0 for the qualified local sharpen default. Create a new RAW session, then for each archived first state time an interactive readback and its first settled canonical readback. Each clock ends after copying the complete frame. No repeating the same state as a warm cache hit. Percentiles use median and nearest-rank p95.

endToEndAgainstLightFlow.boundary: From the interactive recipe input to the first visible, first exact and final complete display readback.
